query_dates <- "
  WITH base_dates AS (
  SELECT start_intervention_dt FROM cirugia_programada_cohort
  UNION ALL SELECT start_intervention_dt FROM cirugia_oncologica_cohort
  UNION ALL SELECT start_intervention_dt FROM cirugia_urgente_cohort
  UNION ALL SELECT start_intervention_dt FROM proceso_medico_cohort
),
ranked_years AS (
  SELECT 
    start_intervention_dt,
    year(start_intervention_dt) AS yr,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY year(start_intervention_dt) DESC) AS yr_rank
  FROM base_dates
)
SELECT 
  MIN(start_intervention_dt) as min_dt, MAX(start_intervention_dt) as max_dt ,
  MIN(CASE WHEN yr_rank = 1 THEN start_intervention_dt END) AS min_dt_max_year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr_rank = 1 THEN start_intervention_dt END) AS max_dt_max_year,
  MIN(CASE WHEN yr_rank = 2 THEN start_intervention_dt END) AS min_dt_prev_year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr_rank = 2 THEN start_intervention_dt END) AS max_dt_prev_year
FROM ranked_years;
"
dates_df <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con, query_dates), error = function(e) data.frame(min_dt=NA, max_dt=NA))

# Función para formatear la diferencia con color 
format_diff_tag <- function(diff_pct, lower_is_better = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(diff_pct) || diff_pct == "-" || is.na(diff_pct)) {
    return('<span style="color: #6c757d;">-</span>')
  }
  
  is_positive <- startsWith(diff_pct, "+") && diff_pct != "+0.0%"
  is_negative <- startsWith(diff_pct, "-")
  
  # Lógica de colores según el flag
  color_up   <- if (lower_is_better) "#dc3545" else "#28a745" # Sube: Rojo si es malo, Verde si es bueno
  color_down <- if (lower_is_better) "#28a745" else "#dc3545" # Baja: Verde si es bueno, Rojo si es malo
  
  if (is_positive) {
    return(sprintf('<span style="color: %s; font-weight: bold;">%s</span>', color_up, diff_pct))
  } else if (is_negative) {
    return(sprintf('<span style="color: %s; font-weight: bold;">%s</span>', color_down, diff_pct))
  } else {
    return(sprintf('<span style="color: #6c757d;">%s</span>', diff_pct))
  }
}

get_ui_data <- function(ind_id, c_name, filter_transf = NULL, var_name = NULL, transftype = NULL) {
  q <- sprintf("select * from %s where cohort = '%s'", ind_id, c_name)
  if (!is.null(filter_transf)) {
    if (filter_transf) q <- paste0(q, " and transfundido_bl is true")
    else q <- paste0(q, " and transfundido_bl is false")
  }
  if (!is.null(transftype)) {
    q <- paste0(q, " and transftype_st = '", transftype, "'")
  }
  q <- paste0(q, " order by month_year")
  
  df <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con_result, q), error=function(e) data.frame())
  
  # Si no hay registros, devolvemos la estructura vacía/por defecto
  if(nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(list(
      vals = "0", 
      ns = "0", 
      last_n = "-", 
      current = "-", 
      prev_val = "-", 
      diff_pct = "-", 
      dates = "-"
    ))
  }
  
  df_m <- df
  
  # Selección de la variable numérica
  if (!is.null(var_name) && var_name %in% names(df_m)) {
    v <- df_m[[var_name]]
  } else if("result" %in% names(df_m)) {
    v <- df_m$result
  } else if("promedio" %in% names(df_m)) {
    v <- df_m$promedio
  } else {
    v <- rep(0, nrow(df_m))
  }
  
  v <- round(as.numeric(v), 1)
  n <- if("n_elegibles" %in% names(df_m)) df_m$n_elegibles else rep(0, nrow(df_m))
  d <- if("month_year" %in% names(df_m)) as.character(df_m$month_year) else rep("-", nrow(df_m))
  
  # Extracción de valor actual y anterior
  val_current  <- tail(v, 1)
  val_previous <- if (length(v) > 1) v[length(v) - 1] else NA
  
  # Cálculo de la diferencia porcentual con formato (+X.X% / -X.X%)
  diff_pct <- if (!is.na(val_previous) && val_previous != 0) {
    pct <- ((val_current - val_previous) / val_previous) * 100
    sprintf("%+.1f%%", pct)
  } else if (!is.na(val_previous) && val_previous == 0 && val_current == 0) {
    "+0.0%"
  } else {
    "-"
  }
  
  list(
    vals     = paste(v, collapse=","), 
    ns       = paste(n, collapse=","),
    last_n   = as.character(tail(n, 1)),
    current  = as.character(val_current),
    prev_val = if (!is.na(val_previous)) as.character(val_previous) else "-",
    diff_pct = diff_pct,
    dates    = paste(d, collapse=",")
  )
}

get_ui_data_extended <- function(ind_id, c_name, filter_transf = NULL, var_name = NULL, transftype = NULL,use_n_transf = FALSE, unit_str ="") {
  q <- sprintf("select * from %s where cohort = '%s'", ind_id, c_name)
  if (!is.null(filter_transf)) {
    if (filter_transf) q <- paste0(q, " and transfundido_bl is true")
    else q <- paste0(q, " and transfundido_bl is false")
  }
  if (!is.null(transftype)) {
    q <- paste0(q, " and transftype_st = '", transftype, "'")
  }
  q <- paste0(q, " order by month_year")
  
  df <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con_result, q), error=function(e) data.frame())
  
  # Si no hay registros, devolvemos la estructura vacía
  if(nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(list(
      vals = "0", vals_median = "0", vals_avg = "0", vals_sd = "0",
      ns = "0", last_n = "-", current = "-", prev_val = "-", diff_pct = "-", dates = "-"
    ))
  }
  
  df_m <- df
  
  # 1. Selección de la variable numérica principal (para las tablas)
  if (!is.null(var_name) && var_name %in% names(df_m)) {
    v <- df_m[[var_name]]
  } else if("result" %in% names(df_m)) {
    v <- df_m$result
  } else if("promedio" %in% names(df_m)) {
    v <- df_m$promedio
  } else {
    v <- rep(0, nrow(df_m))
  }
  
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  
  # 2. Mediana (puntos rojos en el gráfico)
  med <- if("mediana" %in% names(df_m)) as.numeric(df_m$mediana) else v
  
  # 3. Cálculo de Media Móvil (k=3) y SD Móvil (width=3)
  n_rows <- length(v)
  avg_roll <- numeric(n_rows)
  sd_roll  <- numeric(n_rows)
  
  for (i in 1:n_rows) {
    # Si estamos en el mes 1 o 2, usamos los datos disponibles (1 o 2 meses)
    # Si es el mes 3 en adelante, usamos los últimos 3 meses (ventana móvil)
    window_vals <- if (i < 3) v[1:i] else v[(i-2):i]
    
    # Calculamos la media de esa ventana
    avg_roll[i] <- mean(window_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Calculamos la SD de esa ventana (requiere al menos 2 valores, sino es 0)
    if (length(window_vals) > 1) {
      # Si hay valores idénticos, sd() puede dar NA, lo aseguramos con is.na
      sd_temp <- sd(window_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_roll[i] <- ifelse(is.na(sd_temp), 0, sd_temp)
    } else {
      sd_roll[i] <- 0
    }
  }
  
  # 4. Redondeo final para pasarlo al HTML limpio
  v      <- round(v, 2)
  med    <- round(med, 2)
  avg    <- round(avg_roll, 2)
  sd_val <- round(sd_roll, 2)
  
  #n <- if("n_elegibles" %in% names(df_m)) df_m$n_elegibles else rep(0, nrow(df_m))
  if (use_n_transf && "n_episodios_transf" %in% names(df_m)) {
    n <- df_m$n_episodios_transf
  } else if ("n_elegibles" %in% names(df_m)) {
    n <- df_m$n_elegibles
  } else if ("n_episodios_inter" %in% names(df_m)) {
    n <- df_m$n_episodios_inter
  } else {
    n <- rep(0, nrow(df_m))
  }
  d <- if("month_year" %in% names(df_m)) as.character(df_m$month_year) else rep("-", nrow(df_m))
  
  # Extracción de valor actual y anterior para la tabla
  #val_current  <- tail(v, 1)
  #val_previous <- if (length(v) > 1) v[length(v) - 1] else NA
  
  # Cálculo de la diferencia porcentual (+X.X% / -X.X%)
  #diff_pct <- if (!is.na(val_previous) && val_previous != 0) {
  #  pct <- ((val_current - val_previous) / val_previous) * 100
  #  sprintf("%+.1f%%", pct)
  #} else if (!is.na(val_previous) && val_previous == 0 && val_current == 0) {
  #  "+0.0%"
  #} else {
  #  "-"
  #}

  
  val_current  <- tail(v, 1)
  val_previous <- if (length(v) > 1) v[length(v) - 1] else NA
  
  date_current  <- tail(d, 1)
  date_previous <- if (length(d) > 1) d[length(d) - 1] else NA
  
  # Extraemos los años (asumiendo formato YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD o únicamente YYYY)
  year_current  <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(substr(date_current, 1, 4)))
  year_previous <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(substr(date_previous, 1, 4)))
  
  # --- Cálculo de la diferencia porcentual con validación de año continuo ---
  diff_pct <- if (!is.na(year_current) && !is.na(year_previous) && (year_current - year_previous == 1)) {
  if (!is.na(val_previous) && !is.na(val_current) && val_previous != 0) {
    pct <- val_current - val_previous
    # %+.1f formatea el número con signo (+/-) y 1 decimal
    # %s inserta la unidad (unit_str)
    sprintf("%+.2f%s", pct, unit_str)
  } else if (!is.na(val_previous) && !is.na(val_current) && val_previous == 0 && val_current == 0) {
    paste0("+0.00", unit_str)
  } else {
    "-"
  }
  } else {
    "-" # Si no son años consecutivos (ej. dif != 1), forzamos "-"
  }

  list(
    vals        = paste(v, collapse=","), 
    vals_median = paste(med, collapse=","),
    vals_avg    = paste(avg, collapse=","),
    vals_sd     = paste(sd_val, collapse=","),
    ns          = paste(n, collapse=","),
    last_n      = as.character(tail(n, 1)),
    current     = as.character(val_current),
    prev_val    = if (!is.na(val_previous)) as.character(val_previous) else "-",
    diff_pct    = diff_pct,
    dates       = paste(d, collapse=",")
  )
}

get_comp_data <- function(c_name) {
  # 1. Consulta SQL a la tabla
  q <- sprintf("
    SELECT month_year, patient_id, episode_id,
           count(distinct composite) as n_composites,
           count(*) filter(where composite_bl) as n_composites_true,
           round(count(*) filter(where composite_bl) * 100.0 / count(distinct composite), 3) as perc_composite
    FROM composite_all_year
    WHERE cohort = '%s'
    GROUP BY month_year, patient_id, episode_id
  ", c_name)
  
  df <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con, q), error=function(e) data.frame())
  
  # Estructura por defecto si no hay datos
  res <- list(
    i_y = list(current="-", last_n="-", diff_pct=NA)
  )
  
  if(nrow(df) == 0) return(res)
  
  # 2. Agrupación Anual
  df_y <- df %>%
    group_by(month_year) %>%
    summarise(
      n_ep = n(),
      promedio = mean(perc_composite, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(month_year)
  
  # 3. Extraemos el valor actual y calculamos la variación (diff_pct)
  if (nrow(df_y) > 0) {
    current_y <- tail(df_y, 1)
    res$i_y$current <- round(current_y$promedio, 2)
    res$i_y$last_n <- current_y$n_ep
    
    # Si tenemos al menos 2 años de histórico, comparamos con el anterior
    if (nrow(df_y) >= 2) {
      prev_y <- tail(df_y, 2)[1, ]
      
      # Calculamos la diferencia numérica
      diff_val <- round(current_y$promedio - prev_y$promedio, 2) 
      
      # Lo convertimos a Carácter con su signo y su %
      if (diff_val > 0) {
        res$i_y$diff_pct <- paste0("+", diff_val, "%")
      } else if (diff_val < 0) {
        res$i_y$diff_pct <- paste0(diff_val, "%") # El negativo ya lo lleva el número
      } else {
        res$i_y$diff_pct <- "0.0%"
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(res)
}


get_comp_data_all_or_none <- function(c_name) {
  # 1. Consulta SQL usando exactamente tu estructura de subconsulta
  # y atacando a la tabla composite_all_year
  q <- sprintf("
    SELECT *
    FROM (
      select * from ( 
        SELECT cohort,
            category_cohort,
            patient_id,
            episode_id,
            month_year,
            count(distinct composite) as n_composites,
            count(*) filter(
                where composite_bl
            ) as n_composites_true,
            round(count(*) filter(where composite_bl) * 100.0 / count(distinct composite), 3) as perc_composite
        FROM composite_all_year
        GROUP BY cohort,
            category_cohort,
            patient_id,
            episode_id,
            month_year
    ) where perc_composite = 100
    or perc_composite = 0) WHERE cohort = '%s'
  ", c_name)
  
  df <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con, q), error=function(e) data.frame())
  
  # Estructura por defecto si no hay datos
  res <- list(
    i_y = list(current="-", last_n="-", diff_pct=NA)
  )
  
  if(nrow(df) == 0) return(res)
  
  # 2. Agrupación Anual: calculamos la media del porcentaje de los episodios
  df_y <- df %>%
    group_by(month_year) %>%
    summarise(
      n_ep = n(),
      promedio = mean(perc_composite, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(month_year)
  
  # 3. Extraemos el valor actual y calculamos la variación (diff_pct) como texto
  if (nrow(df_y) > 0) {
    current_y <- tail(df_y, 1)
    res$i_y$current <- round(current_y$promedio, 2)
    res$i_y$last_n <- current_y$n_ep
    
    # Si tenemos al menos 2 periodos de histórico, comparamos con el anterior
    if (nrow(df_y) >= 2) {
      prev_y <- tail(df_y, 2)[1, ]
      
      # Calculamos la diferencia numérica
      diff_val <- round(current_y$promedio - prev_y$promedio, 2) 
      
      # Lo convertimos a Carácter con su signo y su %
      if (diff_val > 0) {
        res$i_y$diff_pct <- paste0("+", diff_val, "%")
      } else if (diff_val < 0) {
        res$i_y$diff_pct <- paste0(diff_val, "%") # El número ya lleva el signo negativo
      } else {
        res$i_y$diff_pct <- "0.0%"
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(res)
}

get_n_total <- function(c_name) {
  tbl <- dplyr::case_when(
    c_name %in% c("prod", "pcad", "icv", "hist_no_onco", "cist_radical") ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort",
    c_name %in% c("ncrl", "ncra", "hist_onco") ~ "cirugia_oncologica_cohort",
    c_name %in% c("ffem") ~ "cirugia_urgente_cohort",
    c_name %in% c("hdig") ~ "proceso_medico_cohort",
    TRUE ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort"
  )
  q <- sprintf("select count(distinct episode_id) as n from main.%s where cohort='%s'", tbl, c_name)
  res <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con, q)$n, error=function(e) 0)
  return(res)
}

get_n_total_years <- function(c_name) {
  tbl <- dplyr::case_when(
    c_name %in% c("prod", "pcad", "icv", "hist_no_onco", "cist_radical") ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort",
    c_name %in% c("ncrl", "ncra", "hist_onco") ~ "cirugia_oncologica_cohort",
    c_name %in% c("ffem") ~ "cirugia_urgente_cohort",
    c_name %in% c("hdig") ~ "proceso_medico_cohort",
    TRUE ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort"
  )
  
  # Concatenamos el sufijo _year a la cohorte
  cohort_year <- paste0(c_name, "_year")
  
  q <- sprintf("
    WITH ranked_years AS (
      SELECT 
        episode_id,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY YEAR(month_year) DESC) AS yr_rank
      FROM main.%s 
      WHERE cohort = '%s'
    )
    SELECT 
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN yr_rank = 1 THEN episode_id END) AS n_max_year,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN yr_rank = 2 THEN episode_id END) AS n_prev_year
    FROM ranked_years
  ", tbl, c_name)
  print(q)
  res <- tryCatch(
    dbGetQuery(con, q), 
    error = function(e) data.frame(n_max_year = 0, n_prev_year = 0)
  )
  
  list(
    n_max_year  = as.numeric(res$n_max_year[1]),
    n_prev_year = as.numeric(res$n_prev_year[1])
  )
}

render_ind_row <- function(meta, i_m, i_y, unit = "%", active = FALSE, is_out = FALSE) {
  # Extraemos título y definición del diccionario
  title <- meta$title
  tip <- meta$tip
  lower_is_better <- isTRUE(meta$lower_is_better)
  classes <- paste(c("ind", if (is_out) "out", if (active) "active"), collapse = " ")
  unit_str <- if (unit != "") paste0(" ", unit) else ""
  
  # Hemos añadido data-medians, data-avgs y data-sds al <tr>
  sprintf(
    '<tr class="%s" data-title="%s" data-monthly="%s" data-medians="%s" data-avgs="%s" data-sds="%s" data-nmonthly="%s" data-dates="%s">
      <td>
        <span class="indicator-name">%s</span>
        <span class="info" data-tip="%s">i</span>
      </td>
      <td class="num">%s</td>
      <td class="num result">%s%s</td>
      <td class="num">%s%s</td>
    </tr>',
    classes,
    title,
    i_m$vals,          # El valor original (por retrocompatibilidad)
    i_m$vals_median,   # NUEVO: Mediana
    i_m$vals_avg,      # NUEVO: Promedio
    i_m$vals_sd,       # NUEVO: Desviación estándar
    i_m$ns,
    i_m$dates,
    title,
    tip,
    i_y$last_n,
    i_y$current,
    unit_str,
    format_diff_tag(i_y$diff_pct,lower_is_better),
    unit_str
  )
}


render_pyramid <- function(c_code) {
  # 1. Identificar la tabla correcta según la cohorte
  tbl <- dplyr::case_when(
    c_code %in% c("prod", "pcad", "icv", "hist_no_onco", "cist_radical") ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort",
    c_code %in% c("ncrl", "ncra", "hist_onco") ~ "cirugia_oncologica_cohort",
    c_code %in% c("ffem") ~ "cirugia_urgente_cohort",
    c_code %in% c("hdig") ~ "proceso_medico_cohort",
    TRUE ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort"
  )
  
  # 2. Consulta SQL exacta
  q_pir <- sprintf("
    select cohort, count(distinct episode_id) as n_episode_id, grupo_edad_cd, sex_cd, año_cd
    from (
      select *, year(start_intervention_dt) as año_cd,
      CASE
        WHEN age_nm >= 0 and age_nm <= 4 THEN '00-04 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 5 and age_nm <= 9 THEN '05-09 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 10 and age_nm <= 14 THEN '10-14 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 15 and age_nm <= 19 THEN '15-19 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 20 and age_nm <= 24 THEN '20-24 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 25 and age_nm <= 29 THEN '25-29 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 30 and age_nm <= 34 THEN '30-34 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 35 and age_nm <= 39 THEN '35-39 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 40 and age_nm <= 44 THEN '40-44 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 45 and age_nm <= 49 THEN '45-49 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 50 and age_nm <= 54 THEN '50-54 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 55 and age_nm <= 59 THEN '55-59 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 60 and age_nm <= 64 THEN '60-64 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 65 and age_nm <= 69 THEN '65-69 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 70 and age_nm <= 74 THEN '70-74 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 75 and age_nm <= 79 THEN '75-79 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 80 and age_nm <= 84 THEN '80-84 años'
        WHEN age_nm >= 85 THEN '85 años o más'
        ELSE NULL
      END as grupo_edad_cd 
      from main.%s 
      where age_nm is not null and sex_cd is not null and cohort = '%s'
    ) group by cohort, grupo_edad_cd, sex_cd, año_cd", tbl, c_code)

  data_piramide <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con, q_pir), error=function(e) data.frame())
  
  out_html <- c()
  
  if(nrow(data_piramide) > 0) {
    # 3. Lógica de cálculo
    data_ <- data_piramide %>% filter(año_cd %in% max(data_piramide$año_cd))
    data_$grupo_edad_cd <- as.factor(data_$grupo_edad_cd)
    data_$sex_cd[data_$sex_cd %in% 1] <- 'Hombres'
    data_$sex_cd[data_$sex_cd %in% 2] <- 'Mujeres'
    data_$sex_cd <- factor(data_$sex_cd)
    data_ <- data_ %>% mutate(percent = round(100*(n_episode_id/sum(n_episode_id)), 1))
     
    agecat <- c('00-04 años','05-09 años','10-14 años', '15-19 años', '20-24 años',
                '25-29 años','30-34 años', '35-39 años','40-44 años','45-49 años',
                '50-54 años','55-59 años','60-64 años','65-69 años','70-74 años',
                '75-79 años','80-84 años','85 años o más')
    sex <- c('Hombres','Mujeres')
    df_combinaciones_pira <- expand.grid(grupo_edad_cd = agecat, sex_cd = sex)
    
    data_ <- suppressMessages(dplyr::left_join(df_combinaciones_pira, data_))
    data_$percent[is.na(data_$percent)] <- 0
    
    max_pct <- max(data_$percent, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (max_pct == 0) max_pct <- 1 
    
    for (g in rev(agecat)) {
      pct_m <- data_$percent[data_$grupo_edad_cd == g & data_$sex_cd == 'Hombres']
      pct_f <- data_$percent[data_$grupo_edad_cd == g & data_$sex_cd == 'Mujeres']
      
      pct_m <- pct_m[1]; pct_f <- pct_f[1] 
      
      w_m <- round((pct_m / max_pct) * 100, 1)
      w_f <- round((pct_f / max_pct) * 100, 1)
      
      g_label <- str_replace(g, " años.*", "")
      if (g == "85 años o más") g_label <- "85+"
      if (g_label == "00-04") g_label <- "0-4"
      if (g_label == "05-09") g_label <- "5-9"
      
      # Mostramos el % solo si es mayor a 0 para no saturar visualmente
      txt_m <- ifelse(pct_m > 0, paste0(pct_m, "%"), "")
      txt_f <- ifelse(pct_f > 0, paste0(pct_f, "%"), "")
      
      # Fila HTML compacta (grid en 3 columnas: Edad, Hombres, Mujeres)
      row_html <- sprintf(
        '<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 35px 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 3.5px 0; font-size: 11px; color: #666;">
           <div style="text-align: right; font-weight: bold; font-size: 10.5px;">%s</div>
           <div style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 5px;">
             <span>%s</span>
             <div style="height: 12px; border-radius: 3px; background: #333; width: %s%%;" title="%s%% hombres"></div>
           </div>
           <div style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: center; gap: 5px;">
             <div style="height: 12px; border-radius: 3px; background: #d71920; width: %s%%;" title="%s%% mujeres"></div>
             <span>%s</span>
           </div>
         </div>', 
        g_label, txt_m, w_m, pct_m, w_f, pct_f, txt_f
      )
      out_html <- c(out_html, row_html)
    }
  } else {
    out_html <- c(out_html, '<div class="muted" style="margin-top: 20px; text-align:center;">No hay datos de edad y sexo suficientes.</div>')
  }
  
  # Leyenda centrada en la parte inferior
  out_html <- c(out_html, '<div class="legend" style="display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:20px; width:100%; margin-top:15px; font-size: 12px; color: #666;">
    <span style="display:flex; align-items:center;"><div style="width:10px; height:10px; background:#333; border-radius:50%; margin-right:6px;"></div>Hombres</span>
    <span style="display:flex; align-items:center;"><div style="width:10px; height:10px; background:#d71920; border-radius:50%; margin-right:6px;"></div>Mujeres</span>
  </div>')
  
  return(paste(out_html, collapse = "\n"))
}


render_complications <- function(c_code) {
  
  tooltips_dict <- c(
    "Cardiovasculares (MACE)" = "Incluye: Arritmia, Paro cardíaco, Edema pulmonar cardiogénico, Infarto de miocardio, Daño miocárdico tras cirugía no cardíaca.",
    "Cerebrovasculares y Neurológicas" = "Incluye: Ictus, Delirium.",
    "Tromboembólicas" = "Incluye: Trombosis venosa profunda, Embolia pulmonar.",
    "Infecciosas" = "Incluye: Infección de localización quirúrgica, Infección del tracto urinario, Infección de origen desconocido, Infección sanguínea Conf.Lab, Neumonía.",
    "Respiratorias" = "Incluye: SDRA.",
    "Gastrointestinales" = "Incluye: Sangrado gastrointestinal, Íleo paralítico.",
    "Quirúrgicas y Hemorrágicas" = "Incluye: Hemorragia postoperatoria, Ruptura anastomótica.",
    "Renales" = "Incluye: Fallo renal agudo.",
    "Hematológicas" = "Incluye: Eventos adversos rel. transfusión."
  )

  # 1. Seleccionar la tabla base correcta
  tbl <- dplyr::case_when(
    c_code %in% c("prod", "pcad", "icv", "hist_no_onco", "cist_radical") ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort",
    c_code %in% c("ncrl", "ncra", "hist_onco") ~ "cirugia_oncologica_cohort",
    c_code %in% c("ffem") ~ "cirugia_urgente_cohort",
    c_code %in% c("hdig") ~ "proceso_medico_cohort",
    TRUE ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort"
  )

  # 2. Query SQL
  q_comp <- sprintf("
    select a.cohort, year(a.start_intervention_dt) as año_cd, count(distinct a.episode_id) as n_episode_id,
    sum((coalesce(b.amic_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.arrythc_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.cardiacc_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.cpec_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.myoinfc_bl, false))::INT) as 'Cardiovasculares (MACE)',
    sum((coalesce(b.deliriumc_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.strokec_bl, false))::INT) as 'Cerebrovasculares y Neurológicas',
    sum((coalesce(b.dvtc_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.pulmemb_bl, false))::INT) as 'Tromboembólicas',
    sum((coalesce(b.bloodinfc_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.pneumc_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.ssinfc_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.uncinfc_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.utic_bl, false))::INT) as 'Infecciosas',
    sum((coalesce(b.ardsc_bl, false))::INT) as 'Respiratorias',
    sum((coalesce(b.gastroc_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.ileusc_bl, false))::INT) as 'Gastrointestinales',
    sum((coalesce(b.postophemc_bl, false) OR coalesce(b.anastomotic_breakdown_bl, false))::INT) as 'Quirúrgicas y Hemorrágicas',
    sum((coalesce(b.akic_bl, false))::INT) as 'Renales',
    sum((coalesce(b.transfaec_bl, false))::INT) as 'Hematológicas'
    from main.%s a
    left join complications b on a.patient_id = b.patient_id and a.episode_id = b.episode_id 
    where a.cohort = '%s'
    group by a.cohort, año_cd", tbl, c_code)

  data_complications <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con, q_comp), error=function(e) data.frame())

  out_html <- c()

  if(nrow(data_complications) > 0) {
    
    data <- data_complications %>% filter(año_cd %in% max(data_complications$año_cd, na.rm=TRUE))
    
    if(nrow(data) == 0) return('<div class="muted">Sin datos de complicaciones.</div>')

    data <- data %>% pivot_longer(!c(cohort, año_cd, n_episode_id), names_to = 'comp', values_to = 'count')
    data$percent <- round(100 * (data$count / data$n_episode_id), 1)

    data_comp_plot <- data %>% 
      dplyr::select(level1=comp, size=percent) %>%
      filter(!is.na(size) & size > 0) %>%
      arrange(desc(size)) 
      
    if(nrow(data_comp_plot) > 0) {
       
       # CSS para el efecto desplegable "Inline"
       css_styles <- '
       <style>
         .comp-item-wrapper { cursor: help; }
         .comp-info-icon { color: #999; font-size: 13px; margin-left: 4px; }
         .comp-tooltip-text {
           max-height: 0;
           opacity: 0;
           overflow: hidden;
           transition: max-height 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease, margin 0.3s ease;
           font-size: 11.5px;
           line-height: 1.3;
           color: #666;
           font-weight: normal;
         }
         /* Al pasar el ratón, desplegamos el texto hacia abajo */
         .comp-item-wrapper:hover .comp-tooltip-text {
           max-height: 80px; 
           opacity: 1;
           margin-top: 4px;
           margin-bottom: 4px;
         }
       </style>
       '
       out_html <- c(out_html, css_styles)

       for(i in 1:nrow(data_comp_plot)) {
         
         categoria <- data_comp_plot$level1[i]
         tooltip_text <- tooltips_dict[categoria]
         
         bar_html <- sprintf(
           '<div style="margin-bottom: 12px;" class="comp-item-wrapper">
              <div class="bar-top" style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:5px; font-size:13px; color:#444;">
                <div style="flex: 1; padding-right: 10px;">
                  <strong>%s <span class="comp-info-icon">&#9432;</span></strong>
                  <div class="comp-tooltip-text">%s</div>
                </div>
                <span style="font-weight:700; margin-left:10px;">%s%%</span>
              </div>
              <div class="bar" style="height:12px; border-radius:999px; background:#eee; overflow:hidden;">
                <span style="display:block; height:100%%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, #111, var(--red)); border-radius:999px; width:%s%%;"></span>
              </div>
            </div>', 
           categoria, tooltip_text, data_comp_plot$size[i], data_comp_plot$size[i]
         )
         out_html <- c(out_html, bar_html)
       }
    } else {
       out_html <- '<div class="muted" style="margin-top: 20px;">No hay complicaciones con prevalencia superior a 0%.</div>'
    }
  } else {
    out_html <- '<div class="muted" style="margin-top: 20px;">No hay datos de complicaciones para esta cohorte.</div>'
  }

  return(paste(out_html, collapse="\n"))
}


render_comorbidities <- function(c_code) {
  # 1. Seleccionar la tabla correcta según la cohorte
  tbl <- dplyr::case_when(
    c_code %in% c("prod", "pcad", "icv", "hist_no_onco", "cist_radical") ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort",
    c_code %in% c("ncrl", "ncra", "hist_onco") ~ "cirugia_oncologica_cohort",
    c_code %in% c("ffem") ~ "cirugia_urgente_cohort",
    c_code %in% c("hdig") ~ "proceso_medico_cohort",
    TRUE ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort"
  )

  # 2. Tu código SQL exacto, parametrizado para la tabla y cohorte
  q_com <- sprintf("
    select cohort, año_cd, count(distinct episode_id) as n_episode_id,
    sum(aids_bl::INT) as 'SIDA',
    sum(ami_bl::INT) as 'Infarto agudo miocardio',
    sum(chf_bl::INT) as 'Insuficiencia cardíaca congestiva',
    sum(ckd_bl::INT) as 'Enfermedad renal crónica',
    sum(copd_bl::INT) as 'EPOC',
    sum(ctp_bl::INT) as 'Patología del tejido conectivo',
    sum(cvd_bl::INT) as 'Enfermedad cerebrovascular',
    sum(dementia_bl::INT) as 'Demencia',
    sum(hemiplegia_bl::INT) as 'Hemiplejia',
    sum(leuk_bl::INT) as 'Leucemia',
    sum(lymph_bl::INT) as 'Linfoma',
    sum(mildliver_bl::INT) as 'Enfermedad Hepática Leve',
    sum(mtx_bl::INT) as 'Metástasis',
    sum(orgdiab_bl::INT) as 'DM con lesión orgánica',
    sum(peptic_bl::INT) as 'Enfermedad ulcerosa',
    sum(pvd_bl::INT) as 'Enfermedad vascular periférica',
    sum(severeliver_bl::INT) as 'Enfermedad hepática moderada/grave',
    sum(tumor_bl::INT) as 'Tumor sólido',
    sum(uncdiab_bl::INT) as 'DM no complicada' 
    from (
      select a.cohort, year(a.start_intervention_dt) as año_cd, b.* 
      from main.%s a
      left join comorbidities b on a.patient_id = b.patient_id and a.episode_id = b.episode_id 
      where a.cohort = '%s'
    ) 
    group by cohort, año_cd", tbl, c_code)

  data_comorbidities <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con, q_com), error=function(e) data.frame())

  out_html <- c()

  if(nrow(data_comorbidities) > 0) {
    
    # 3. Tu lógica de procesamiento R
    data <- data_comorbidities %>% 
      filter(año_cd %in% max(data_comorbidities$año_cd, na.rm=TRUE))
    
    if(nrow(data) == 0) return('<div class="muted">Sin datos de comorbilidades.</div>')

    data <- data %>% pivot_longer(!c(cohort,año_cd,n_episode_id), names_to = 'comor', values_to = 'count')
    data$percent <- round(100*(data$count/data$n_episode_id), 1)

    data <- data %>% dplyr::select(level1=comor, size=percent)

    # 4. Filtramos las Top 10 con prevalencia > 0
    data_comor_plot <- data %>%
      filter(!is.na(size) & size > 0) %>%
      arrange(desc(size)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10)
      
    if(nrow(data_comor_plot) > 0) {
       # 5. Generamos el HTML iterando sobre tus datos calculados
       for(i in 1:nrow(data_comor_plot)) {
         bar_html <- sprintf(
           '<div style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
              <div class="bar-top" style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:5px; font-size:13px; color:#444;">
                <strong>%s</strong><span style="font-weight:700;">%s%%</span>
              </div>
              <div class="bar" style="height:12px; border-radius:999px; background:#eee; overflow:hidden;">
                <span style="display:block; height:100%%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, #111, var(--red)); border-radius:999px; width:%s%%;"></span>
              </div>
            </div>', 
           data_comor_plot$level1[i], data_comor_plot$size[i], data_comor_plot$size[i]
         )
         out_html <- c(out_html, bar_html)
       }
    } else {
       out_html <- '<div class="muted" style="margin-top: 20px;">No hay comorbilidades con prevalencia superior a 0%.</div>'
    }
  } else {
    out_html <- '<div class="muted" style="margin-top: 20px;">No hay datos de comorbilidades para esta cohorte.</div>'
  }

  return(paste(out_html, collapse="\n"))
}



render_global_activity <- function(cohorts_list) {
  # cohorts_list debe ser un vector con nombre, ej: c("prod" = "Prótesis de Rodilla", "pcad" = "Prótesis de Cadera")
  
  # 1. Generar el selector (Dropdown)
  out_html <- c('<div class="panel" style="padding:22px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff;">')
  
  out_html <- c(out_html, '<div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 20px;">')
  out_html <- c(out_html, '<h2 style="margin: 0;">Actividad cargada por procedimiento</h2>')
  out_html <- c(out_html, '<select id="cohort-activity-selector" style="padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #ccc; font-size: 14px; background: #f9f9f9;" onchange="changeActivityCohort(this.value)">')
  
  for (c_code in names(cohorts_list)) {
    out_html <- c(out_html, sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', c_code, cohorts_list[[c_code]]))
  }
  out_html <- c(out_html, '</select></div>')
  
  # 2. Bucle para generar los datos, tabla y gráfico de CADA cohorte
  for (c_code in names(cohorts_list)) {
    
    # Identificar tabla
    tbl <- dplyr::case_when(
      c_code %in% c("prod", "pcad", "icv", "hist_no_onco", "cist_radical") ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort",
      c_code %in% c("ncrl", "ncra", "hist_onco") ~ "cirugia_oncologica_cohort",
      c_code %in% c("ffem") ~ "cirugia_urgente_cohort",
      c_code %in% c("hdig") ~ "proceso_medico_cohort",
      TRUE ~ "cirugia_programada_cohort"
    )
    
    # Extraer datos SQL
    q_act <- sprintf("
      SELECT year(start_intervention_dt) as anio, count(distinct episode_id) as n_ep
      FROM main.%s
      WHERE cohort = '%s' AND start_intervention_dt IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY anio ORDER BY anio", tbl, c_code)
    
    df_act <- tryCatch(dbGetQuery(con, q_act), error=function(e) data.frame())
    
    # Ocultar todos por defecto excepto el primero
    display_style <- ifelse(c_code == names(cohorts_list)[1], "grid", "none")
    
    out_html <- c(out_html, sprintf('<div id="act-%s" class="activity-view" style="display: %s; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; align-items: start;">', c_code, display_style))
    
    if (nrow(df_act) > 0) {
      # --- INICIO TABLA ---
      out_html <- c(out_html, '<div><table class="caption-top" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">')
      out_html <- c(out_html, '<thead><tr class="header" style="border-bottom: 2px solid #ccc; text-align: left;"><th>Año / periodo</th><th class="num" style="text-align: right;">Episodios</th></tr></thead><tbody>')
      
      total <- 0
      for(i in 1:nrow(df_act)) {
        total <- total + df_act$n_ep[i]
        anio_label <- df_act$anio[i]        
        bg_color <- ifelse(i %% 2 == 1, "#f9f9f9", "#ffffff")
        out_html <- c(out_html, sprintf('<tr style="background-color: %s; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;"><td style="padding: 8px;">%s</td><td class="num" style="padding: 8px; text-align: right;">%s</td></tr>', 
                                        bg_color, anio_label, format(df_act$n_ep[i], big.mark=".", scientific=FALSE)))
      }
      out_html <- c(out_html, sprintf('<tr style="border-top: 2px solid #ccc;"><td style="padding: 8px;"><strong>Total</strong></td><td class="num" style="padding: 8px; text-align: right;"><strong>%s</strong></td></tr>', format(total, big.mark=".", scientific=FALSE)))
      out_html <- c(out_html, '</tbody></table></div>')
      
      # --- INICIO GRÁFICO DE BARRAS ---
      max_ep <- max(df_act$n_ep, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (max_ep == 0) max_ep <- 1
      
      out_html <- c(out_html, '<div style="background: #fff; padding: 10px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-around; height: 100%; min-height: 250px; border-bottom: 2px solid #eaeaea;">')
      
      for (i in 1:nrow(df_act)) {
        h_pct <- round((df_act$n_ep[i] / max_ep) * 90, 1)
        col_html <- sprintf(
          '<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; height: 100%%; width: 100%%; max-width: 50px;">
             <span style="font-size: 13px; color: #555; margin-bottom: 5px; font-weight: bold;">%s</span>
             <div style="height: %s%%; width: 100%%; background: linear-gradient(0deg, #111, var(--red)); border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; min-height: 2px;" title="%s episodios en %s"></div>
             <span style="font-size: 14px; margin-top: 10px; color: #333; font-weight: 500;">%s</span>
           </div>',
          format(df_act$n_ep[i], big.mark=".", scientific=FALSE), h_pct, df_act$n_ep[i], df_act$anio[i], df_act$anio[i]
        )
        out_html <- c(out_html, col_html)
      }
      out_html <- c(out_html, '</div>')
      
    } else {
      out_html <- c(out_html, '<div class="muted" style="grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; padding: 40px;">No hay datos de actividad para esta cohorte.</div>')
    }
    
    out_html <- c(out_html, '</div>') # Cierre del activity-view de la cohorte
  }
  
  # 3. JavaScript para hacer funcionar el desplegable
  js_script <- "
  <script>
    function changeActivityCohort(selectedCode) {
      // Ocultar todas las vistas
      var views = document.querySelectorAll('.activity-view');
      views.forEach(function(view) {
        view.style.display = 'none';
      });
      // Mostrar solo la seleccionada
      var activeView = document.getElementById('act-' + selectedCode);
      if(activeView) {
        activeView.style.display = 'grid';
      }
    }
  </script>
  "
  out_html <- c(out_html, js_script, '</div>') # Cierre del panel principal
  
  return(paste(out_html, collapse="\n"))
}

<style>
:root{--red:#d71920;--darkred:#8f1014;--soft:#fde9ea;--soft2:#fff3f3;--black:#111;--bg:#f7f7f7;--line:#ddd;--muted:#666;--green:#137a3f;--bad:#b42318}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);font-family:Segoe UI,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#1f1f1f;line-height:1.45}

.layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:270px 1fr;min-height:100vh}
.sidebar{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;overflow:auto;background:#111;color:#fff;padding:24px 20px;border-right:6px solid var(--red)}
.brand{font-weight:950;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:16px;height:16px;background:var(--red);border-radius:50%;margin-right:9px}

.period{font-size:12px;background:#191919;border:1px solid #333;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin:20px 0;color:#e5e5e5}
.period div{margin-bottom:8px}
.period div:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

.nav-title{margin:22px 0 8px;color:#aaa;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;font-weight:850}
.nav a{display:block;color:#f0f0f0;text-decoration:none;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:9px;font-size:13px}
.nav a:hover{background:#292929}

.main{padding:30px 42px 72px;max-width:1580px}
.hero{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-radius:28px;padding:25px 32px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 150px;gap:24px;align-items:center;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #0002}
.report-title{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:900}
.hospital-title{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:36px;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:950}
.hero p{margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45}
.hero strong{font-weight:900}
.logo{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 10px 24px #0003;justify-self:end}
.logo img{max-width:110px;display:block}

.section{margin-top:34px;scroll-margin-top:24px}
h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:27px}
h3{margin:0 0 14px}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

.proc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:16px}
.proc-card,.panel,.proc-title,.summary{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #0001}
.proc-card{padding:16px;min-height:126px}
.proc-card:hover{box-shadow:0 16px 36px #0002;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.tag{display:inline-block;background:var(--soft);color:var(--darkred);border:1px solid #f1b9bc;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;font-weight:900;font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.15}
.n{font-size:35px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.epis{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}

.proc-title{padding:22px;border-left:7px solid var(--red);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--soft),#fff)}
.summary-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:16px}
.summary{padding:18px}
.sl{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;min-height:38px}
.sv{font-size:34px;font-weight:950;margin-top:6px}
.sc{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}
.improve{color:var(--green);font-weight:950}
.worse{color:var(--bad);font-weight:950}

.tabs{display:flex;margin-top:26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow-x:auto}
.tabs button{border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:0;background:#fff;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;margin-right:6px;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer}
.tabs button.active{background:#111;color:#fff;border-color:#111;box-shadow:inset 0 4px 0 var(--red)}
.tab{display:none;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 18px 18px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #0001}
.tab.active{display:block}

/* ------------- MEJORAS DE LAYOUT Y TABLAS RESPONSIVE ------------- */
.ind-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:30px;align-items:start}
.ind-layout > div{min-width:0;}
.ind-layout > div:first-child{overflow-x:auto;}

table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px}
/* Celda flex para que el texto conviva pacíficamente con la info 'i' */
table td:first-child{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;}

th,td{padding:12px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;text-align:left}
th{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
tr.ind{cursor:pointer}
tr.ind:hover{background:#fafafa}
tr.ind.active{background:var(--soft);outline:2px solid #f2b9bb}
.result{font-weight:950}

/* Nombre del indicador con salto de línea permitido */
.indicator-name{flex:1;white-space:normal !important;overflow:visible !important;text-overflow:clip !important;line-height:1.3;vertical-align:middle}

/* Icono de info 'i' (Se quitó el :hover:after que causaba recortes en el scroll) */
.info{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:17px;height:17px;margin-left:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#eee;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;cursor:help;vertical-align:middle;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px;}

/* NUEVO TOOLTIP GLOBAL JS (Flota por encima de toda la web sin recortarse) */
.global-tooltip{position:fixed;background:#111;color:#fff;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;z-index:999999;font-weight:500;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0004;pointer-events:none;max-width:340px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity 0.15s ease;}
.global-tooltip.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible;}
/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- */

.chart-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px;background:#fff;position:sticky;top:20px}
.chart-card svg{width:100%;height:auto;max-width:620px;}
.ct{font-size:18px;font-weight:950}
.cs{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:3px 0 14px}
.chart-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.chart-tabs button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.chart-tabs button.active{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red)}
.chart{height:270px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 24%,#eee 24.5%,transparent 25%),linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 49%,#eee 49.5%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 74%,#eee 74.5%,transparent 75%),#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.chart svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-top:10px}
.tipbox{display:none;position:absolute;background:#111;color:#fff;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;pointer-events:none;z-index:30;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0004;line-height:1.35}

.placeholder{border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:30px;color:var(--muted);background:#fafafa}
.chars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:22px}
.pyramid{height:360px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;background:#fff}
.pyr-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:55px 1fr 1fr 45px;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:8px 0;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.male,.female{height:17px;border-radius:999px}
.male{background:#333;justify-self:end}
.female{background:var(--red);justify-self:start}
.legend{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:24px;margin-top:18px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.legend .m:before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;background:#333;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px}
.legend .f:before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;background:var(--red);border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px}

.bar-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:14px}
.bar{height:11px;border-radius:999px;background:#eee;overflow:hidden}
.bar span{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#111,var(--red));border-radius:999px}
.mini-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:18px}
.mini{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;padding:15px}
.mini .v{font-size:27px;font-weight:950;margin-top:4px}

.comp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px}
.comp-main{padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px}
.comp-value{font-size:42px;font-weight:950}
details.comp-detail{margin-top:16px}
details.comp-detail summary{font-weight:850;cursor:pointer;color:var(--darkred)}
.comp-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 70px 120px;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eee}
.spark{height:32px;border:1px solid #eee;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#eee,#fff)}
.filters input{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 8px;font-size:12px}
.activity{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px}
.notes-list details{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:13px 15px;margin-bottom:10px;background:#fff}
.notes-list summary{font-weight:850;cursor:pointer}
.notes-list p{color:var(--muted);margin:10px 0 0}

@media(max-width:1300px){.proc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}

@media(max-width:1180px){
    .layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .sidebar{position:relative;height:auto}
    .hero,.proc-grid,.summary-grid,.ind-layout,.chars,.comp-grid,.activity,.mini-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .main{padding:24px}
    .logo{justify-self:start}
    .chart-card{position:relative}
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .ind-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr; 
  }
}

#quarto-content, .quarto-container, main.content {padding:0 !important; margin:0 !important; max-width:none !important}

</main></div>

<script>

function drawLine(svgId, tipId, values, ns, datesArray = []) {
  
  if(!values || values[0]==="" || values[0]==="0") return;
  const svg = document.getElementById(svgId), tip = document.getElementById(tipId);
  if(!svg || !tip) return;
  
  const nums = values.map(Number);
  const nvals = ns.map(Number);
  
 

  // Validamos fechas
  const dates = nums.map((_, i) => {
    let d = (datesArray && datesArray[i]) ? datesArray[i].trim() : "";
    if (d.includes("-")) {
      const parts = d.split("-");
      if (parts.length >= 2) return `${parts[0]}-${parts[1]}`; // YYYY-MM
    }
    return d !== "" ? d : "-";
  });

  const w = 620, h = 270, px = 35, py = 28;
  const min = Math.min(...nums), max = Math.max(...nums), range = (max - min) || 1;
  
  const pts = nums.map((v, i) => [
    px + i * ((w - 2 * px) / (nums.length - 1)),
    h - py - ((v - min) / range) * (h - 2 * py),
    v,
    nvals[i] !== undefined ? nvals[i] : (nvals[0] || "-"), // <-- Fallback de seguridad para N
    dates[i]
  ]);

  const firstPt = pts[0];
  const lastPt = pts.at(-1);

  const xAxisHTML = `
    <line x1="${px}" y1="${h - py + 8}" x2="${w - px}" y2="${h - py + 8}" stroke="#ddd" stroke-width="1.5"></line>
    <text x="${firstPt[0]}" y="${h - 8}" text-anchor="start" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#666">${firstPt[4]}</text>
    <text x="${lastPt[0]}" y="${h - 8}" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#666">${lastPt[4]}</text>
  `;

  svg.innerHTML = `
    <polyline points="${pts.map(p => p[0] + "," + p[1]).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="4"></polyline>
    ${pts.map((p, i) => `<circle class="pt" cx="${p[0]}" cy="${p[1]}" r="6" fill="#d71920" data-i="${i}"></circle>`).join("")}
    <text x="${lastPt[0] - 8}" y="${lastPt[1] - 12}" text-anchor="end" font-size="13" font-weight="800">${nums.at(-1)}</text>
    ${xAxisHTML}
  `;

  svg.querySelectorAll(".pt").forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
      const p = pts[+el.dataset.i];
      tip.innerHTML = `<strong>Mes/Periodo: ${p[4]}</strong><br>Resultado: ${p[2]}<br>N: ${p[3]}`;
      tip.style.display = "block";
      tip.style.left = Math.min(e.offsetX + 12, 470) + "px";
      tip.style.top = Math.max(e.offsetY - 54, 8) + "px";
    });
    el.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => tip.style.display = "none");
  });
}

function drawStatisticalChart(svgId, tipId, medians, avgs, sds, ns, datesArray = []) {
  if(!medians || medians[0]==="") return;
  const svg = document.getElementById(svgId), tip = document.getElementById(tipId);
  if(!svg || !tip) return;
  svg.innerHTML = "";

  if(!medians || medians[0] === "" || (medians.length === 1 && datesArray[0] === "-")) {
    svg.innerHTML = `<text x="50%" y="50%" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#999">Sin datos históricos suficientes</text>`;
    return;
  }

  // Convertir a números
  const numMedians = medians.map(Number);
  const numAvgs = avgs.map(Number);
  const numSds = sds.map(Number);
  const nvals = ns.map(Number);

  // Validamos fechas
  const dates = numMedians.map((_, i) => {
    let d = (datesArray && datesArray[i]) ? datesArray[i].trim() : "";
    if (d.includes("-")) {
      const parts = d.split("-");
      if (parts.length >= 2) return `${parts[0]}-${parts[1]}`; // YYYY-MM
    }
    return d !== "" ? d : "-";
  });

  // Aumentamos px a 45 para dejar espacio a las etiquetas del eje Y
  const w = 620, h = 270, px = 45, py = 35; 
  const len = numMedians.length;
  
  // Calcular el mínimo y máximo global (incluyendo las bandas SD)
  let allValues = [];
  for(let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    allValues.push(numMedians[i]);
    allValues.push(numAvgs[i] + numSds[i]);
    allValues.push(numAvgs[i] - numSds[i]);
  }
  let min = Math.min(...allValues);
  let max = Math.max(...allValues);
  
  // Ajuste inteligente del rango del eje Y
  if (min === max) {
    // Si todos los valores son idénticos (ej. todo 100 o todo 0)
    if (min === 0) {
      max = 10; // Rango artificial de 0 a 10
    } else {
      min = min * 0.8; // Baja un 20%
      max = max * 1.2; // Sube un 20%
    }
  } else {
    // Si hay variación, damos un margen del 10% arriba y abajo para que no toque los bordes del SVG
    const pad = (max - min) * 0.1;
    min = min - pad;
    max = max + pad;
  }
  
  const range = max - min;
  
  // Funciones de mapeo de coordenadas
  const mapX = (i) => px + i * ((w - 2 * px) / (len - 1));
  const mapY = (val) => h - py - ((val - min) / range) * (h - 2 * py);

  // Helper para formatear los números del eje Y sin decimales excesivos
  const formatY = (v) => Number.isInteger(v) ? v : v.toFixed(1);
  const mid = (max + min) / 2;

  // NUEVO: Crear la cuadrícula y las etiquetas del eje Y
  const yAxisHTML = `
    <!-- Líneas horizontales -->
    <line x1="${px}" y1="${mapY(max)}" x2="${w - px}" y2="${mapY(max)}" stroke="#f0f0f0" stroke-width="1"></line>
    <line x1="${px}" y1="${mapY(mid)}" x2="${w - px}" y2="${mapY(mid)}" stroke="#f0f0f0" stroke-width="1"></line>
    <line x1="${px}" y1="${mapY(min)}" x2="${w - px}" y2="${mapY(min)}" stroke="#f0f0f0" stroke-width="1"></line>

    <!-- Textos del eje Y -->
    <text x="${px - 8}" y="${mapY(max) + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10" fill="#999">${formatY(max)}</text>
    <text x="${px - 8}" y="${mapY(mid) + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10" fill="#999">${formatY(mid)}</text>
    <text x="${px - 8}" y="${mapY(min) + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10" fill="#999">${formatY(min)}</text>
  `;

  // 1. Crear la banda de suavizado (Promedio +- SD)
  const upperPts = [], lowerPts = [];
  for(let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    const x = mapX(i);
    upperPts.push(`${x},${mapY(numAvgs[i] + numSds[i])}`);
    lowerPts.push(`${x},${mapY(numAvgs[i] - numSds[i])}`);
  }
  const sdPolygon = `<polygon points="${upperPts.join(' ')} ${lowerPts.reverse().join(' ')}" fill="rgba(215, 25, 32, 0.15)"></polygon>`;

  // 2. Crear la línea media móvil (Promedio)
  const avgPts = numAvgs.map((v, i) => `${mapX(i)},${mapY(v)}`).join(' ');
  const avgLine = `<polyline points="${avgPts}" fill="none" stroke="#666" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5,5"></polyline>`;

  // 3. Crear los puntos sueltos (Valor / Mediana)
  const medianCircles = numMedians.map((v, i) => 
    `<circle class="pt" cx="${mapX(i)}" cy="${mapY(v)}" r="3" fill="#d71920" data-i="${i}" style="cursor:pointer;"></circle>`
  ).join('');

  // 4. Crear la LEYENDA (Ubicada en la parte superior)
  const legendHTML = `
    <g transform="translate(${px}, 12)">
      <circle cx="5" cy="0" r="3" fill="#d71920"></circle>
      <text x="15" y="4" font-size="11" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="#555">Valor</text>
      
      <line x1="60" y1="0" x2="85" y2="0" stroke="#666" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4"></line>
      <text x="93" y="4" font-size="11" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="#555">Media móvil</text>
      
      <rect x="175" y="-5" width="20" height="10" fill="rgba(215, 25, 32, 0.15)"></rect>
      <text x="203" y="4" font-size="11" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="#555">Desviación estándar (SD)</text>
    </g>
  `;

  // Eje X y etiquetas de inicio/fin
  const firstX = mapX(0);
  const lastX = mapX(len - 1);

  const xAxisHTML = `
    <line x1="${px}" y1="${h - py + 8}" x2="${w - px}" y2="${h - py + 8}" stroke="#ddd" stroke-width="1.5"></line>
    <text x="${firstX}" y="${h - 8}" text-anchor="start" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#666">${dates[0]}</text>
    <text x="${lastX}" y="${h - 8}" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#666">${dates.at(-1)}</text>
  `;

  // Inyectar el SVG (Fondo: Eje Y -> Leyenda -> Banda -> Línea -> Puntos -> Eje X)
  svg.innerHTML = `
    ${yAxisHTML}
    ${legendHTML}
    ${sdPolygon}
    ${avgLine}
    ${medianCircles}
    ${xAxisHTML}
  `;

  // Eventos de Tooltip
  svg.querySelectorAll(".pt").forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
      const i = +el.dataset.i;
      const nData = nvals[i] !== undefined ? nvals[i] : (nvals[0] || "-");
      
      tip.innerHTML = `<strong>Mes/Periodo: ${dates[i]}</strong>
Valor: <strong>${numMedians[i]}</strong>
Media: ${numAvgs[i].toFixed(1)} (SD: ±${numSds[i].toFixed(1)})
N: ${nData}`;
      tip.style.display = "block";
      tip.style.left = Math.min(e.offsetX + 12, 470) + "px";
      tip.style.top = Math.max(e.offsetY - 54, 8) + "px";
    });
    el.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => tip.style.display = "none");
  });
}

function selectRow(row){
  const tab = row.closest('.tab');
  if (!tab) return;
  
  tab.querySelectorAll("tr.ind:not(.out)").forEach(r=>r.classList.remove("active"));
  row.classList.add("active");
  
  // Extraemos la base del ID del tab (ej: de "tab-pilar1-prod" a "pilar1-prod")
  const tabIdBase = tab.id.replace('tab-', '');
  
  const titleEl = document.getElementById("chart-title-" + tabIdBase);
  if(titleEl) {
      titleEl.textContent = row.dataset.title;
  }
  
  // Capturamos los nuevos atributos (con fallback seguro al antiguo 'monthly')
  const mediansRaw = row.dataset.medians || row.dataset.monthly;
  const avgsRaw    = row.dataset.avgs || row.dataset.monthly;
  const sdsRaw     = row.dataset.sds || "0"; 
  const nraw       = row.dataset.nmonthly;
  const datesRaw   = row.dataset.dates;   
  
  // Llamamos a la nueva función de gráficos estadísticos
  drawStatisticalChart(
    "chart-svg-" + tabIdBase, 
    "tipbox-" + tabIdBase, 
    mediansRaw ? mediansRaw.split(",") : ["0"], 
    avgsRaw ? avgsRaw.split(",") : ["0"],
    sdsRaw ? sdsRaw.split(",") : ["0"],
    nraw ? nraw.split(",") : ["0"], 
    datesRaw ? datesRaw.split(",") : []
  );
}

function selectOutRow(row){
  const section = row.closest('.section');
  if (!section) return;
  const suffix = secMap[section.id];
  
  const tab = row.closest('.tab');
  if(tab) tab.querySelectorAll("tr.out").forEach(r=>r.classList.remove("active"));
  row.classList.add("active");
  
  const titleEl = document.getElementById("out-chart-title-" + suffix);
  if(titleEl) {
      titleEl.textContent = row.dataset.title;
  }
  
  // Capturamos los nuevos atributos (con fallback seguro)
  const mediansRaw = row.dataset.medians || row.dataset.monthly;
  const avgsRaw    = row.dataset.avgs || row.dataset.monthly;
  const sdsRaw     = row.dataset.sds || "0";
  const nraw       = row.dataset.nmonthly;
  const datesRaw   = row.dataset.dates;   
  
  // Llamamos a la nueva función de gráficos estadísticos
  drawStatisticalChart(
    "out-chart-svg-" + suffix, 
    "out-tipbox-" + suffix, 
    mediansRaw ? mediansRaw.split(",") : ["0"], 
    avgsRaw ? avgsRaw.split(",") : ["0"],
    sdsRaw ? sdsRaw.split(",") : ["0"],
    nraw ? nraw.split(",") : ["0"],
    datesRaw ? datesRaw.split(",") : []
  );
}

// Map of sections to suffixes
const secMap = {
  "rodilla": "prod", 
  "cadera": "pcad", 
  "colorectal-lap": "ncrl", 
  "colorectal-open": "ncra", 
  "fractura-femur": "ffem", 
  "hister-onco": "hist_onco", 
  "hister-no-onco": "hist_no_onco", 
  "cardiaca": "icv", 
  "cistectomia": "cist_radical", 
  "hgi": "hdig"
};

// Bind Tabs
document.querySelectorAll(".tabs button").forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=(e)=>{
  const section = e.target.closest('.section');
  section.querySelectorAll(".tabs button").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));
  section.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("active"));
  btn.classList.add("active");
  
  const targetTab = document.getElementById("tab-"+btn.dataset.tab);
  if(targetTab) {
    targetTab.classList.add("active");
    
    // Al cambiar de pestaña, forzamos la carga del gráfico de la primera fila activa
    if(targetTab.id.includes("outcomes")) {
        const r2 = targetTab.querySelector("tr.out.active") || targetTab.querySelector("tr.out");
        if(r2) selectOutRow(r2);
    } else {
        const r1 = targetTab.querySelector("tr.ind.active:not(.out)") || targetTab.querySelector("tr.ind:not(.out)");
        if(r1) selectRow(r1);
    }
  }
});

// Bind Table Rows
document.querySelectorAll(".section").forEach(sec => {
  const suffix = secMap[sec.id];
  if(!suffix) return;
  
  sec.querySelectorAll("tr.ind:not(.out)").forEach(row => row.onclick=()=>selectRow(row));
  sec.querySelectorAll("tr.out").forEach(row => row.onclick=()=>selectOutRow(row));
  
  // Initialize first rows
  setTimeout(() => {
    const tab1 = sec.querySelector(".tab.active");
    if(tab1) {
        const r1 = tab1.querySelector("tr.ind.active:not(.out)");
        if(r1) selectRow(r1);
    }
  }, 100);
});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  // 1. Creamos el tooltip flotante global una sola vez y lo inyectamos en el body
  const globalTip = document.createElement("div");
  globalTip.className = "global-tooltip";
  document.body.appendChild(globalTip);

  // 2. Escuchamos cuando el ratón entra en un icono 'i'
  document.addEventListener("mouseover", (e) => {
    if (e.target.classList.contains("info") && e.target.dataset.tip) {
      globalTip.innerHTML = e.target.dataset.tip;
      globalTip.classList.add("show");
    }
  });

  // 3. Hacemos que el tooltip persiga al ratón de forma suave
  document.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
    if (globalTip.classList.contains("show")) {
      // Posición inicial (un poco separada del cursor)
      let x = e.clientX + 15;
      let y = e.clientY + 15;
      
      // Inteligencia: Si el tooltip se va a salir de la pantalla por la derecha, lo volteamos a la izquierda
      const rect = globalTip.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (x + rect.width > window.innerWidth) {
        x = e.clientX - rect.width - 15;
      }
      // Inteligencia: Si se sale por abajo, lo subimos
      if (y + rect.height > window.innerHeight) {
        y = e.clientY - rect.height - 15;
      }

      globalTip.style.left = x + "px";
      globalTip.style.top = y + "px";
    }
  });

  // 4. Ocultamos el tooltip al sacar el ratón
  document.addEventListener("mouseout", (e) => {
    if (e.target.classList.contains("info")) {
      globalTip.classList.remove("show");
    }
  });
});


</script>
